Android requires that all APKs be digitally signed with a certificate before they are installed on a device or updated. When releasing using Android App Bundles , you need to sign your app bundle with an upload key before uploading it to the Play Console, and Play App Signing takes care of the rest. For apps distributing using APKs on the Play Store or on other stores, you must manually sign your APKs for upload.
